verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS feedback-management product like Canny, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-premise, or open-source deployment option. The materials describe only Canny's hosted portal, SDK and widget embeds, integrations, API and hosted MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
